title: Embedding + Reranker validation pipeline and pinned-version publish flow
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Implement an automated validation and publishing pipeline for paired embedding + reranker model artifacts that enforces compatibility checks, performance gates, and produces a signed performance profile manifest to be published to the model catalog. This ticket covers: 1) runtime compatibility checks (dimensionality, tokenization, dtype), 2) automated micro-benchmarks across expected request distributions (latency p50/p95/p99, throughput under batching, memory/KV footprint), 3) golden prompt scoring to detect quality regressions for the reranker, 4) artifact manifest signing and pin metadata for stable production pins, and 5) integration with the catalog publish API so PMs can approve and release pinned profiles. The flow should surface clear failure reasons and remediation steps in the console and produce audit entries for private deployments.
tasks: Design manifest schema for paired embed+reranker artifacts (fields: model_id, variant, dims, quantization, tokens, checksum, benchmark_summary, golden_scores, compatible_runtime_tags)
Add runtime compatibility unit that verifies dtype, embedding dim, tokenizer mapping, and model signature before acceptance
Create micro-benchmark harness that runs 1k sample requests across batching configs (batch sizes 1/8/32) and records latency/throughput/memory
Implement golden prompt scoring harness for reranker with configurable threshold and delta-based regression detection
Add CI job that signs manifests with KMS key and pushes artifacts to artifact-store with versioned pin tags
Extend catalog publish API to accept signed profile manifests and mark pinned versions as eligible for dedicated/private rollouts
Build console UX endpoint to show profile publish status, test results, and allow PM approval
Add tracing hooks to record per-request kernel selection and KV cache hit rates during benchmark runs
Document rollout plan and rollback criteria in the onboarding runbook
Add unit/integration tests and follow-up e2e smoke tests on staging cluster
acceptance_criteria: A schema-backed manifest is produced for each embed+reranker pair and signed with KMS before publish
Micro-benchmark runs populate perf fields (p50/p95/p99, throughput at B1/B8/B32, memory) and the outputs are reproducible within ±10% across 3 runs
Golden prompt harness flags reranker quality regressions automatically with an actionable diff and links to counterexamples
Publish flow writes an audit entry and surfaces pass/fail in Console with ability for PM to approve or reject
Pinned version metadata is returned by catalog API and used by serving runtime to route requests to pinned artifacts
